summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR), a foreign private issuer, reporting its second-quarter 2026 earnings results. The filing contains standard financial highlights including passenger traffic, revenue, EBITDA, and net income, along with an earnings call notice. There is no mention of any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The content is purely an ordinary periodic earnings release with no extraordinary corporate action. Therefore, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
